description: Unnamed numbers in an upload route and a toast: a byte limit and a daily quota compared inline, a day in milliseconds computed inline, and a toast timeout on the closing `}, 4000);` line that Prettier gives any multi-statement timer callback (the old timer check only matched single-line calls). Arithmetic constants such as `Date.now() - 86400000` are not detected — a known gap, since flagging large literals in arithmetic would also hit every unit conversion.
